_about: What this library is and what it reads. subject_library.py create fills the name, id, subject words and STCW references. A path is '{LIB}/...' (this folder, wherever it sits), relative to this folder, or absolute (a folder on one person's computer - a colleague changes it to their own copy). Add a course with tools/contribute.py register-course, then run tools/build_library.py.
_reviewers: Who reviews knowledge/INBOX.md and decides CONFLICT rows - put their names here.
_ship_states: Only these may go on the tablets. Everything else is classroom reference until cleared.
_publishers: A picture whose source names one of these and records no licence is a PUBLICATION_FIGURE (classroom reference only).
_generic_words: Words too common on this subject to stand for a glossary term in the synonym search.

courses.title: Contributions - pictures found or made while building a course (tools/contribute.py)
courses.status: added by course sessions - provenance in each record

_document_roots: Folders outside the library holding original reference PDFs. A PDF put into documents/<type>/ needs no entry here.

knowledge_bases.title: This library's own documents/ - made searchable by build_library.py with the factory's kb_build.py
